title: Senior Manager - Copy
description: Responsibilities Lead the content and copy team with clarity, empathy, and high creative standards Own HUFT’s brand voice and narrative across platforms and touchpoints Conceptualise and drive brand campaigns, launches, collaborations, and partnerships Ensure all communication is rooted in a deep understanding of pet parents, culture, and context Lead, mentor, and develop the content and copy team, Guide writers from brief to execution, helping them think strategically as well as creatively, Foster a culture of strong ideas, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Own and evolve HUFT’s brand voice to ensure it remains warm, honest, and relatable, Develop a deep understanding of our customers — their needs, emotions, and realities as pet parents, Ensure all content feels human, relevant, and grounded in real insight. Conceptualise and lead brand campaigns, product and sub-brand launches, and seasonal moments. Develop central ideas that translate seamlessly across content, design, video, social, retail, and digital. Partner closely with design, visual communications, Social, and marketing teams to bring ideas to life. Shape the creative thinking behind brand collaborations, partnerships, and influencer-led initiatives. Develop strong narratives and content frameworks that feel authentic to HUFT. Work closely with internal and external partners to ensure consistency and quality. Shape the creative thinking behind brand collaborations, partnerships, and influencer-led initiatives. Develop strong narratives and content frameworks that feel authentic to HUFT. Work closely with internal and external partners to ensure consistency and quality Oversee content across all touchpoints — campaigns, social media, films, product packaging, e-commerce, retail communication, blogs, scripts, and more. Ensure clarity, consistency, and excellence across formats and platforms. Act as a creative partner to Brand, Marketing, Design, Visual Communications, Product, and Retail teams. Contribute to broader brand and business conversations through a communication lens. Ensure content supports both brand-building and business priorities. Minimum Qualifications, Skills and Competencies 6–8 years of experience in content, copywriting, or brand communications Proven experience leading teams and shaping brand narratives Strong conceptual thinking and storytelling ability Excellent writing and editing skills across formats Ability to understand customers deeply and communicate with empathy Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-moving environment Being a pet parent is strongly preferred
